newsitem.title: USA: Kohl arrives to mark Marshall Plan, meet Clinton.
newsitem.headline: Kohl arrives to mark Marshall Plan, meet Clinton.

text.p: German Chancellor Helmut Kohl arrived in Washington on Wednesday for talks with President Bill Clinton and for ceremonies marking the 50th anniversary of the Marshall Plan.

Kohl was due to meet Clinton for a private dinner at an Italian restaurant in the historic Georgetown district on Wednesday evening and attend a morning wreath-laying and evening gala to commemorate the work of former Secretary of State George Marshall.
Under the Marshall plan, which he briefly outlined in a speech at Harvard University on June 5, 1947, the United States provided billions of dollars in aid to rebuild Europe after World War Two.
